summary.headline: Afternoon sun, 1 to 5 hours a day
summary.subline: From about 14:45 until about 17:45. Most in May, least in December.

advice:
Verdict: Afternoon sun only, strongest in May with 5.2 h and weakest in Dec with 1.2 h.
Blocked by: the white building to the west around 0.27 h/day, plus railing and plant
Good for: afternoon coffee, heat-loving potted herbs, quick laundry drying
Not for: morning sunbathing, all-day solar, full-sun vegetables
Tip: Put pots at the rail edge for afternoon rays and shade pets in May.
